scares.description: A young girl with a distorted face slams against the car window.
A woman is seen in a bathroom mirror with a distorted face, her eyes and mouth open wide.
A young girl with a distorted face slams against the car window (a repeat of the first jump scare).
A man sitting in the waiting room suddenly has a distorted grin.
Dan slams his face against the car window, cracking the glass.
Humanoid monsters slam against the car windows and Beth screams.
Humanoid monsters bust through the wall, and a little girl monster slams against the window.
Two humanoid monsters are slowly swallowing the arms of a man.
There is a humanoid monster woman in the photo with a distorted face, causing screaming.
A kid wearing a pig mask suddenly appears in the back window.
There is muffled voice and a monster woman with a distorted face is illuminated by a flashlight.
A monster humanoid wearing a horse mask suddenly pulls the car door off.
The kid in the pig mask rushes into the car and starts eating Terry.
Jeff knocks over something on the ground which makes a loud noise.
Some humanoid monsters suddenly appear right in front of Jeff.
The passengers on the bus all rush at a woman and eat her.
